en.summary: Shared selection, hover and focus; Chromium
details: dir                  Published site directory; default: public
--headed             Show the browser window
--trace              Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>          Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>       Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--page <path>        Article with a selected source row and another path row, e.g. /article/#from=all
--collection <path>  Collection page with entry links for hover and focus checks
--choices <path>     Appearance settings page with light and dark choice buttons; default: /appearance/
--widths <list>      Comma-separated viewport widths; test height: 900 pixels; default: 1440
swban check/browser/collection/style ./preview --page /article/#from=all --collection /all/
swban check/browser/collection/style ./preview --page /zh/article/#from=all --collection /zh/all/ --choices /zh/appearance/ --widths 390,1440
dir                  已完成的站点构建目录；默认：public
--headed             显示浏览器窗口
--trace              保存 trace.zip；默认输出到系统临时目录
--out <dir>          在新子目录保存 JSON 和截图
--timeout <ms>       浏览器启动和单次操作的超时，单位为毫秒；默认：15000
--page <path>        含选中来源行和另一路径行的文章，例如 /article/#from=all
--collection <path>  用于检查悬停和焦点状态的集合页
--choices <path>     包含浅色和深色选项的外观设置页；默认：/appearance/
--widths <list>      视口宽度，用逗号分隔；检查高度为 900 像素；默认：1440
swban check/browser/collection/style ./preview --page /article/#from=all --collection /all/
swban check/browser/collection/style ./preview --page /zh/article/#from=all --collection /zh/all/ --choices /zh/appearance/ --widths 390,1440
